title: Israel’s CorNeat developed an artificial cornea, and Jamal Furani, 78, from Haifa regained his sight

trailer.text: CorNeat Vision is an Israeli company from Ra’anana, founded in 2015, that develops clinical-stage biomimetic implant technology.
The company developed an artificial cornea that integrates with the eye wall and requires no donor tissue.
In January 2021, Prof. Irit Bahar, director of the Ophthalmology Department at Rabin Medical Center in Petah Tikva, implanted it in the eye of Jamal Furani, a 78-year-old blind man from Haifa.
He regained his sight a day after the surgery, and according to the company he was able to read text and recognize family members.
Since then the device has been implanted in 10 patients in a first study, and the trial is continuing at centers in several countries.

paragraphs.text: According to CORDIS, corneal opacity is the second leading cause of blindness worldwide, with 29.5 million patients.
According to the same source, only 185,000 cases are treated with a donor cornea each year.
Worldwide, one cornea suitable for transplantation is obtained for every 70 blind eyes waiting in line.
About twenty percent of corneal transplants lose transparency within the first year, and within 5–10 years the failure rate reaches about half.
According to CORDIS, 20% of patients are not suitable for transplantation, because the tissue will not maintain its transparency.
Prof. Livny of Beilinson said that a donor cornea can be kept in the cornea bank for up to two weeks from retrieval.
According to the Israel Hayom article, any artificial implant is considered a foreign body by the immune system, and this is the main problem with artificial corneas.
According to CORDIS, all previous attempts to develop an artificial cornea failed to integrate reliably with the eye.
Prof. Livny said that artificial corneas are used only in rare cases, in the most severe eye diseases.
CorNeat Vision was founded by Dr. Gilad Litvin and Almog Aley-Raz.
Litvin, the inventor of the CorNeat KPro and the company’s Chief Medical Officer, moved from eye surgery to entrepreneurship in the medtech field.
Aley-Raz is the Chief Executive Officer and VP R&D.
In its announcement, the company describes itself as a clinical-stage biomimetic implant technology company.
It also developed the CorNeat EverPatch.
According to the Start-Up Nation Central database, as cited in a Times of Israel article on the first implantation, the company had raised $12.3 million from investors as of that article.
The implant consists of an optical lens in the center and a flexible skirt around it.
According to the article, it is made of a fully synthetic, non-degradable porous material, and it replaces scarred or deformed corneas without donor tissue.
The skirt is made of a nanofabric material manufactured by a chemical engineering process called electrospinning.
The device is anchored beneath the conjunctiva, and the skirt serves as a scaffold onto which cells (fibroblasts) from Tenon’s capsule can migrate.
The rim of the device has three pairs of holes for non-degradable sutures, which anchor it to the eye wall.
At the end of the surgery, the conjunctiva is repositioned, sutured over the skirt with biodegradable sutures, and sealed with fibrin glue.
Studies in rabbits helped establish surgical feasibility and biocompatibility.
In 2020 the company was granted approval to move forward to clinical trials in 10 patients with corneal blindness.
According to the company, the implant does not trigger an adverse immune response.
The company says it is the first artificial cornea that completely integrates with the eye wall with no reliance on donor tissue.
In a YouTube video, the company said the implantation process is relatively simple and takes less than an hour.
Jamal Furani from Haifa was 78.
Fox News described him as a legally blind Israeli man.
He had been blind for the past decade.
He underwent several operations to save his sight with corneal transplants from donors, and all of them failed.
According to CORDIS, he had failed four transplantations.
According to Kikar HaShabbat, physicians of the ophthalmology department at Beilinson believed this was medicine’s last resort for saving his eyesight.
The first trial included blind patients who were not suitable candidates for a standard transplant or had failed one or more transplants.
The surgery was performed by Prof. Irit Bahar, director of the Ophthalmology Department at Rabin Medical Center in Petah Tikva.
She performed the first in-human implantation of the prosthesis in January 2021.
On January 11, 2021, the company from Ra’anana announced that the CorNeat KPro had been successfully implanted in a human.
Prof. Bahar said the surgery was straightforward and that the result exceeded all expectations.

According to Kikar HaShabbat, the technology, which is undergoing clinical trials, "has been approved for use by the Israeli Ministry of Health," but the report does not specify whether this is an approval that goes beyond the clinical trial.

stations.title: The next day: reading, recognizing family

paragraphs.text: Furani regained his sight a day after the surgery.
According to the company, when the bandages were removed he was able to read text and recognize family members.
ISRAEL21c described him as a 78-year-old grandfather from Haifa whose vision was restored.
Dr. Gilad Litvin said that after years of hard work, seeing a colleague implant the device with ease and a person regain his sight the following day was very moving.
Litvin reported that the first patient has optic nerve damage, and that seven months after implantation he is very pleased.
According to CORDIS, more than three years after the surgery the first patient is still enjoying his vision and independence.
10 patients were approved for the clinical trial at Rabin Medical Center, and two additional sites were planned to open in Canada.
The first-in-human study was concluded with the implantation of the device in 10 patients, most of whom had previously been defined as terminally blind.
The second patient had not been able to see for 30 years, and three months after implantation his visual acuity was 6/9.
According to Dr. Litvin, the first two patients were doing well during follow-up of three to seven months.
In a 2025 announcement, the company reported on another patient, who had been blinded by corneal scarring from shingles and regained perfect vision.
Almog Aley-Raz said the first implantation is just the first step in a multi-national clinical trial geared toward CE, FDA and China approvals.
According to him, the company plans a second study with broader indications, to approve the cornea as a first-line treatment in place of donor tissue.
The RESEE trial is being conducted at clinical centers in Canada, France, India, Israel and the Netherlands.
China has about 5 million people with corneal blindness, and only about 5,000 corneal transplants are performed there each year.
The company is backed by an Israeli-Chinese fund and plans a first clinical trial in China.
Near its offices, the company set up an initial production line capable of producing thousands of corneas a month.
According to CORDIS, a robotic cell that was built enables the production of about 200 devices a day.
A second generation of the prosthesis, which will include an embedded intraocular pressure sensor, is in development.
The CorNeat KPro project is supported by the European Innovation Council and by a U.S. Army Project Award.
Prof. Bahar said the team is proud to be at the forefront of the project, which she said will undoubtedly impact the lives of millions.
She also said that the success of the trial would bring truly good news to many blind people, and could shorten or eliminate a wait of years for donor transplants.
In the first two patients, some conjunctival retraction was observed in the first weeks after surgery.
In the first patient, this left about 1.5 mm of the device rim without conjunctival covering, but he is not bothered by it.
Surgical difficulties in the first five patients led to formal amendments to the clinical protocol.
According to CORDIS, difficulties in the implantation procedure in the first-in-human study and a case of suspected infection led to the explantation of some of the devices.
Patients whose device was removed received a tectonic corneal graft, to maintain their vision potential.
According to CORDIS, the initial results of the second study are very positive, but longer follow-up is needed to prove the advantages.

claims.text: פרופ' בכר אמרה שהניתוח היה פשוט והתוצאה עלתה על כל הציפיות.
claims.quote: The surgical procedure was straight forward and the result exceeded all of our expectations.

claims.text: הטכנולוגיה, שנמצאת בניסוי קליני, אושרה לשימוש על ידי משרד הבריאות הישראלי.
claims.quote: הטכנולוגיה שנמצאת בתהליכי ניסוי קליני, אושרה לשימוש על ידי משרד הבריאות הישראלי.

claims.text: ישראל21c תיארה את המטופל כסבא בן 78 מחיפה שראייתו הוחזרה בהשתלה ראשונה בבני אדם.
claims.quote: First-in-human implantation of the CorNeat KPro restores vision of 78-year-old grandfather from Haifa.

claims.text: ד"ר גלעד ליטוין סיפר שאחרי שנים של עבודה קשה, לראות עמית משתיל את ההתקן בקלות ואדם חוזר לראות למחרת היה מרגש מאוד.
claims.quote: After years of hard work, seeing a colleague implant the CorNeat KPro with ease and witnessing a fellow human being regain his sight the following day was electrifying and emotionally moving

claims.text: ליטוין דיווח שלמטופל הראשון יש נזק לעצב הראייה, ושבעה חודשים אחרי ההשתלה הוא רואה 6/90 והוא מרוצה מאוד.
claims.quote: The patient has optic nerve damage, but at seven months after implantation, he is seeing 6/90 (~20/320) and is very pleased,

claims.text: לפי CORDIS, המטופל הראשון, יותר משלוש שנים אחרי הניתוח, עדיין נהנה מראייה ועצמאות.
claims.quote: Our first patient, who is now more than three years post op (implanted prior to the RESEE project initiation), is still enjoying his vision and independence.

claims.text: 10 מטופלים אושרו לניסוי הקליני במרכז הרפואי רבין, ושני אתרים נוספים תוכננו להיפתח בקנדה.
claims.quote: A total of 10 patients are approved for the clinical trial at Rabin Medical Center in Israel with two additional sites planned to open this month in Canada

claims.text: המטופל השני לא ראה במשך 30 שנה, ושלושה חודשים אחרי ההשתלה חדות הראייה שלו הייתה 6/9.
claims.quote: The second patient had a history of ocular cicatricial pemphigoid and had not been able to see for 30 years. At three months following keratoprosthesis implantation, his visual acuity was 6/9 (~20/30).

claims.text: שני המטופלים הראשונים שהושתלו בקרנית הסינתטית מתפקדים היטב במעקב של שלושה עד שבעה חודשים, לפי ד"ר ליטוין.
claims.quote: The first two patients implanted with a completely synthetic keratoprosthesis (CorNeat KPro, CorNeat Vision) are doing well during follow-up ranging from three to seven months

claims.text: בהודעת 2025 דווח על מטופל אחר שהיה עיוור בעקבות צלקת קרנית משלבקת חוגרת וחזר לראייה מושלמת באמצעות ה-KPro.
claims.quote: has announced a groundbreaking clinical achievement: the restoration of perfect vision in a patient blinded by corneal scarring caused by Shingles

claims.text: לפי אלמוג אלי-רז, ההשתלה הראשונה בבן אדם היא רק צעד ראשון בניסוי קליני רב-לאומי המכוון לאישורי CE, FDA וסין.
claims.quote: The CorNeat KPro's first-in-human implantation is just the first step in a multi-national clinical trial, geared toward attaining CE Mark, FDA Clearance and China NMPA approval.

claims.text: אלי-רז אמר שהחברה מתכננת מחקר שני עם התוויות רחבות יותר, כדי לאשר את הקרנית כטיפול קו ראשון במקום רקמת תורם.
claims.quote: we plan to initiate a second study later this year with broader indications to approve our artificial cornea as a first line treatment, displacing the use of donor tissue used in full thickness corneal transplantations.

claims.text: בסין יש כ-5 מיליון עיוורים על רקע קרנית.
claims.quote: בסין קיים אחד ממשברי העיוורון הגדולים בעולם: כ-5 מיליון אנשים עיוורים על רקע קרנית.

claims.text: בסין מתבצעות רק כ-5,000 השתלות קרנית בשנה.
claims.quote: לעומת זאת, מתבצעות שם רק כ-5,000 השתלות קרנית בשנה.

claims.text: החברה נתמכת בקרן ישראלית-סינית ומתכננת ניסוי קליני ראשון בסין.
claims.quote: היא נתמכת בידי קרן GIBF, קרן ישראלית-סינית ייעודית ומתכננת לפתוח ניסוי קליני ראשון במדינה בחודשים הקרובים

claims.text: החברה הקימה בסמוך למשרדיה קו ייצור ראשוני המסוגל לייצר אלפי קרניות בחודש.
claims.quote: קורנית גם הקימה בסמוך למשרדיה קו ייצור ראשוני, המסוגל לייצר אלפי קרניות מלאכותיות בחודש

claims.text: תא רובוטי שנבנה מאפשר ייצור של כ-200 התקנים ביום.
claims.quote: supports the production of ~200 devices a day by integrating a customized industrial electrospinning machine, a robotic arm

claims.text: מפותח דור שני של התותבת שיכלול חיישן לחץ תוך-עיני משובץ.
claims.quote: Work is underway to develop a second generation of the keratoprosthesis that will have an embedded IOP sensor.

claims.text: פרופ' בכר אמרה שהצוות גאה להיות בחזית הפרויקט, שלדבריה ישפיע ללא ספק על חייהם של מיליונים.
claims.quote: We are proud of being at the forefront of this exciting and meaningful project which will undoubtedly impact the lives of millions.

claims.text: פרופ' בכר אמרה שהצלחת הניסוי תביא בשורה של ממש לעיוורים רבים ועשויה לקצר או לבטל המתנה של שנים להשתלות מתורמים.
claims.quote: תביא בשורה של ממש עבור עיוורים רבים בעולם ועשויה לקצר ואף לבטל המתנה ארוכה של שנים להשתלות קרנית ביולוגיות

claims.text: בשני המטופלים נצפתה נסיגה מסוימת של הלחמית בשבועות הראשונים לאחר הניתוח.
claims.quote: Some conjunctival retraction was observed during the first few weeks postoperatively in both patients.

claims.text: אצל המטופל הראשון הנסיגה הותירה כ-1.5 מ"מ משולי ההתקן ללא כיסוי לחמית, אך הוא אינו מוטרד מכך.
claims.quote: In the first patient, conjunctival retraction has left approximately 1.5 mm of the device rim without conjunctival covering, but the patient is not bothered by it

claims.text: קשיים כירורגיים בחמשת המטופלים הראשונים הובילו לתיקונים רשמיים בפרוטוקול הקליני.
claims.quote: Surgical challenges that were encountered during the first 5 patients were addressed by the company, these resulted in formal amendments to the clinical protocol

claims.text: לפי CORDIS, קשיים בהשתלה הראשונה ומקרה של חשד לזיהום הובילו להוצאת חלק מההתקנים.
claims.quote: While some difficulties during the first-in-human implantation procedure as well as an unfortunate case of suspected infection led to the explantation of some devices

claims.text: מטופלים שההשתל הוצא להם קיבלו שתל קרנית טקטוני כדי לשמר את פוטנציאל הראייה שלהם.
claims.quote: patients who underwent a procedure to remove the implant were provided with a tectonic corneal graft so as to maintain their vision potential.

claims.text: לפי CORDIS, התוצאות הראשוניות של המחקר השני חיוביות מאוד, אך נדרש מעקב ארוך יותר להוכחת היתרונות.
claims.quote: The initial results are very positive, but a longer follow-up is required in order to fully prove the advantages of the device.

claims.text: לפי Ophthalmology Times, הניתוח בוצע ב-11 בינואר בידי פרופ' בכר במרכז הרפואי רבין בפתח תקווה.
claims.quote: The procedure was performed Jan. 11 by Professor Irit Bahar, the head of the ophthalmology department at Rabin Medical Center in Petah Tikva, Israel.

claims.text: לפי פוקס ניוז, פוראני עבר את הניתוח, שנמשך פחות משעה, בחודש הקודם.
claims.quote: during the less than an hour long operation last month, the Times of Israel reported.

claims.text: פוקס ניוז דיווח שפוראני סבל מבצקת בעין ומחלות נוספות שהפכו אותו לעיוור על פי חוק במשך כעשור.
claims.quote: Furani suffered from edema of the eye and other diseases that rendered him legally blind for about a decade, the outlet said.

claims.text: לפי ישראל היום, לאחר התאוששות קצרה ראייתו של המטופל שבה לרמה של 6/6.
claims.quote: ולאחר התאוששות קצרה שבה ראייתו לרמה של 6/6

claims.text: הניתוח בוצע בגבר בן 78 עיוור בשתי עיניו במרכז הרפואי רבין, בידי פרופ' אירית בכר, מנהלת מחלקת העיניים.
claims.quote: The surgery was performed on a bilaterally blind, 78-year-old male at Rabin Medical Center, Israel, by Professor Irit Bahar, Director of the Ophthalmology Department.

claims.text: למטופל הראשון הייתה עין אחת מתפקדת שעברה ארבע השתלות קרנית.
claims.quote: The first recipient of the synthetic keratoprosthesis had one functioning eye that had undergone four corneal transplantation procedures.

quote_translations.c59: Worldwide, one cornea suitable for transplantation is obtained for every 70 blind eyes waiting in line.
quote_translations.c60: About twenty percent of corneal transplants lose transparency already in the first year, and after 5-10 years the failure rate reaches about half
quote_translations.c79: The vial is kept in refrigerators at the cornea bank, and it can be kept for up to two weeks from retrieval.
quote_translations.c61: Any artificial implant is considered a foreign body by the immune system
quote_translations.c77: These are rare cases, and the solution to these problems is the use of corneal prostheses, that is, artificial corneas.
quote_translations.c78: This is done in the most severe diseases of the eye, if we know in advance that a corneal graft from a human donor will not take
quote_translations.c63: the expert behind the company, to turn from a successful eye surgeon into an entrepreneur in the medtech field
quote_translations.c62: CorNeat developed an implant composed of two parts: a central optical lens, and around it
quote_translations.c26: The patient underwent a large number of operations in which attempts were made to save his sight through biological corneal transplants from donors
quote_translations.c57: A patient who suffered from total blindness following a severe corneal infection underwent a transplant of a new artificial cornea
quote_translations.c27: Physicians of the ophthalmology division at Beilinson believe that this is the last resort medicine has to offer him in order to save his eyesight
quote_translations.c29: The technology, which is in the process of clinical trials, was approved for use by the Israeli Ministry of Health.
quote_translations.c64: China has one of the largest blindness crises in the world: about 5 million people blind due to corneal causes.
quote_translations.c65: By contrast, only about 5,000 corneal transplants are performed there each year.
quote_translations.c66: It is backed by the GIBF fund, a dedicated Israeli-Chinese fund, and plans to open a first clinical trial in the country in the coming months
quote_translations.c68: CorNeat also set up near its offices an initial production line, capable of producing thousands of artificial corneas a month
quote_translations.c30: will bring truly good news for many blind people in the world and may shorten and even eliminate a long wait of years for biological corneal transplants
quote_translations.c58: and after a short recovery his vision returned to a level of 6/6
